Home › Respite Care

Respite Services

Short-term relief for caregivers

Respite Care provides temporary care so caregivers can rest, recharge, and take care of their own needs — knowing their loved one is in caring, capable hands.

Ask About Respite Care →☎ (303) 335-7064

How respite helps

Caring for someone you love is rewarding — and demanding. Respite gives family caregivers time back, without giving up quality of care.

  • Rest and recharge — take time for your own health, work, family, and errands.
  • Temporary, trusted care — your loved one continues to receive compassionate support while you step away.
  • Peace of mind — care from the same team committed to safety, independence, and dignity.
  • Short-term support — while the usual caregiver takes a break.
  • Daily routines and personal care — help with daily routines and personal care while you step away.
  • Meals and preferred activities — support with meals and preferred activities.
Waiver availability: Respite Care is available under CES and SLS waivers. Contact us to talk through eligibility and scheduling: (303) 335-7064 · unitedcarecenterinfo@gmail.com

Need a break? We're here.

Reach out to arrange respite care or to ask how CES and SLS waiver respite works.

Home › Transportation (NEMT & NMT)

Medical and non-medical rides

SODAK Transportation provides ambulatory and wheelchair accessible rides for both Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) and Non-Medical Transportation (NMT). We accept Medicaid — so getting there is never the barrier.

Ask About Transportation →☎ (303) 335-7064

We provide ambulatory and wheelchair accessible rides for both NEMT and NMT.

✓ We accept Medicaid
✚ Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)

Rides for scheduled healthcare appointments.

  • Doctor and specialist visits
  • Dialysis appointments
  • Physical and occupational therapy
  • Lab tests and imaging appointments
  • Outpatient treatments and procedures
  • Medical follow-up visits
  • Hospital discharges
👥 Non-Medical Transportation (NMT)

Rides for everyday needs and community activities.

  • Grocery shopping and essential errands
  • Day programs
  • Work and job training
  • Community centers and activities
  • Social and recreational outings
